args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money() was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP, which broke the nightly
build (tests/test_money.py expects ROUND_HALF_EVEN). Switch the import and
rounding mode to match the documented FIN-212 behavior.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change
- Switched `round_money()` in `src/money.py` to import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).
